title: Mercury heading
description: Calm, medium-weight grotesk heading with an optional full-width hairline above it. Five sizes from the 65px hero line to small card titles, with optional chosen line breaks.
notes: set at in-between weights (420–480): pick a variable typeface
name: mercury-heading

props.name: title
props.description: the heading; pass a list to choose where the lines break (from sm up)

props.name: rule
props.description: a full-width hairline above the heading, as Mercury opens most sections

props.name: size
props.description:
hero: 36 → 65px · statement: 28 → 42px (centred lines) · section: 24 → 32px ·
sub: 21 → 24px (beside tab lists) · card: 21 → 28px
